title: What If Sharks Suddenly Stopped Swimming?
subject: great white shark

scenes.text: What if every shark stopped swimming right now? Some would be fine. Some would not.
Great whites, makos and whale sharks have lost the muscles to pump water over their gills.
They breathe only by swimming with their mouths open, so water is forced across the gills.
Stop moving, and no new water flows past. These sharks would run out of oxygen.
Nurse sharks would simply lie down. They pump water with their mouths and breathe through holes behind the eyes.
Even gray reef sharks, once thought to be swimmers only, were filmed napping on a reef ledge in 2022.

description:
What if sharks stopped swimming? For great whites, makos and whale sharks, it would be fatal.
They breathe by forcing water over their gills as they move, while nurse sharks can pump water and rest.
